remarks:
This stately, brick, Kenmore home exudes character and style, blending timeless charm with a complete renovation and a gorgeous, light-filled open floor plan! Step inside the large entry foyer and discover an the soaring 9 foot ceilings, expansive living room anchored by a gas fireplace, creating an inviting setting for relaxing evenings and lively gatherings. 

The spacious dining room flows beautifully from the living area, offering plenty of room to host everything from intimate dinners to holiday celebrations. The stunning kitchen showcases white shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, sleek brushed gold hardware, stainless steel appliances, creating a fresh, polished look, while new flooring throughout ties the home's beautifully updated spaces together. 
A conveniently located half bath completes the main level. 

On the second floor, four large bedrooms provide generous space to unwind, and the glamour bath impresses with a striking tiled feature wall and elegant fixtures. 

The incredible third floor adds 460 sq. ft of space totaling (2,230 sq ft.) more versatility, featuring vaulted ceilings with sleek black ceiling fans and LVP flooring—perfect for a spacious lounge, home office, recreation room, or creative retreat. 

From the dining room, step outside through the sliding glass patio doors onto the rear composite deck overlooking the huge DOUBLE LOT, with exceptional space for outdoor entertaining, gardening, and enjoying the open surroundings. 

With its commanding brick exterior, spacious interior, and thoughtfully renovated finishes, this Kenmore home delivers character, comfort, and style at every turn. Nothing to do but move in and enjoy!
